minutes.headline: PACC voted to draft a policy letting it choose its own recording equipment, after bad audio at the water district meeting.
minutes.summary: The committee heard the director's report on a new production technician, programming growth, the auditorium multi-camera test and a copyright question over movie clips. Poor audio at the water district annual meeting led to a motion to draft an equipment policy, with a second reading planned. A personal-equipment waiver policy was also read, and a motion to adopt it pending approval and editing was put, with the result not clearly audible.

Neither vote result is audible, so whether either policy was approved cannot be confirmed from this recording; the town's official minutes would settle it.
